title: Awebound analytics events
description: Every custom event the site sends to PostHog, keyed by event name under $defs. track() in src/lib/analytics.ts accepts only these names and exactly these properties, so a change starts here. Properties never carry an email, a name, an address or anything else that identifies a person, and nothing a visitor typed except the shop search (shop_filtered.search), which the Privacy page names. PostHog's own events ($pageview, $pageleave, $autocapture, $exception, $identify, $web_vitals) are not listed.

product_added_to_bag.description: A shopper adds a piece to the bag from its product page.

product_category.description: The piece's category slug, as in the shop's category filter.

price_cents.description: The unit price for that size, in US cents.

checkout_started.description: The bag was handed to the hosted checkout; the browser is about to leave the site. Payment happens there and is not tracked here.

subtotal_cents.description: Their subtotal before shipping and tax, in US cents.

checkout_failed.description: Check out was pressed but checkout didn't start: a piece in the bag isn't published yet, or the checkout partner is unavailable.

preview_in_bag.description: Whether the bag held a piece that isn't published in Fourthwall yet.

shop_filtered.description: The shop's search, collection, category, sort or filters changed. Each property is the URL value after the change, or null when unset.

piece_saved.description: A signed-in shopper saves a piece to My Archive with its heart.

saved_piece_removed.description: A signed-in shopper removes a saved piece, from its heart or from My Archive's saved list.

sign_in_google_started.description: A visitor chose Continue with Google; the browser is about to leave for Google.

sign_in_link_requested.description: A visitor asked for an email sign-in link and code, and it was sent.

back_in_stock_notification_requested.description: A shopper asked to be emailed when a sold-out size comes back.

contact_message_sent.description: A visitor sent a message with the contact form.

topic.description: The topic chosen in the form.

profile_updated.description: A signed-in shopper saved a new display name in Settings.

email_change_requested.description: A signed-in shopper asked to change their email address; confirmation links were sent.

order_claim_started.description: A signed-in shopper entered a past order's number and a code was sent to the email on that order.

order_claim_completed.description: The code was accepted and the order is now linked to the shopper's account.

orders_refreshed.description: A signed-in shopper refreshed their orders from the checkout partner.

changed_order_count.description: Orders that were new or changed.

idea_submitted.description: A signed-in shopper sent an Idea Submission from My Archive.

image.description: Whether the submission included an image.

checkout_invite_shown.description: A signed-out shopper pressed Check out while Founding Member places remain, and the invitation to sign in first opened.

checkout_invite_answered.description: The shopper answered the invitation before checkout: sign in or create an account, or continue as a guest.

answer.description: join went to sign-in with the bag kept; guest went on to checkout.

guest_order_notice_shown.description: A guest's order arrived and the band under the header invited them into My Archive, on their next visit after checking out.

guest_order_notice_answered.description: A guest answered the band after their order: Create your free Archive, or Not now.

answer.description: join went to sign-in; not_now hid the band for that order.
